mentions.name: 3D-printed car key fob shell
mentions.description: A personal learning project to design and 3D print a shell for a car key fob, covering the buttons to prevent accidentally pressing them and setting off the car alarm; the builder is learning CAD and 3D printing through this project.
mentions.problem: The builder keeps leaning on the key fob's buttons and setting off the car alarm, and the buttons are unnecessary since the car can be locked/unlocked while the fob is in a pocket.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm trying to learn CAD and 3d printing.

For the moment, I'm trying to design a shell for my car key fob. I keep leaning on the buttons and setting the car alarm off; I also never need to touch the buttons on the fob, because the car has a button for me to lock / unlock it as long as the fob is in my pocket.
